I can't verify this. I have no access to the Dispatch repository and no tools, and I don't recall the specific function or threshold. Anything I name below is a guess from how the feature seems to work, not something I know.

When a repeat signal is folded into an existing case, the code that posts the signal message into the case's conversation thread is probably in the signal flow code, `src/dispatch/signal/flows.py`. A gating check there likely compares the current time with the last time the alert message was re-posted for that case. I can't name that function or its threshold with any confidence. The values below are placeholders, and the time gap in particular is a guess.

To confirm, search the repo for where the case conversation thread is updated after a signal is deduplicated into a case. Grep for terms like `dedup`, `signal_instance`, `conversation`, `thread`, and `timedelta`.

FILE: src/dispatch/signal/flows.py (unverified guess)
FUNCTION: unknown, I could not identify it without the repository
MIN_GAP: unknown (a guess would be 1 hour, but I have no basis to confirm it)
